text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder narrowly misses out on 
victory.

Her shoulders slumped, feeling that even 
like this, she wouldn't have been able to 
beat Maruzensky, who didn't run.

After the race, Seiun Sky comes over and 
tells Grass Wonder, "You were full of 
openings."

Those words made Grass Wonder realize that 
she hadn't been taking her matches against 
them seriously.
